lines.label: Executive Fellowship delivery sequence
lines.description: The eight-course premium cohort sequence that organizes the shared One Water AI body of knowledge into a 24-week applied program.

groups.title: AI Fluency for One Water
groups.promise: Build a shared language for AI and connect every term to a recognizable utility task, decision, or consequence.

groups.title: Data, Knowledge, and Trusted Context
groups.promise: Understand why useful AI depends on connected records, shared meaning, current sources, permission, and traceable evidence.

groups.title: Agents, Skills, and Orchestration
groups.promise: See how AI moves from a response to bounded work, then design the instructions, tools, handoffs, permissions, and stop conditions required to keep people in control.

groups.title: Utility Applications and Opportunity Design
groups.promise: Move from generic AI excitement to a disciplined portfolio of opportunities grounded in utility work, available evidence, affected people, and measurable value.

groups.title: Governance, Security, and Human Authority
groups.promise: Build governance into the design so that the organization knows what the system may do, what it may not do, who checks it, and what evidence survives.

groups.title: Strategy, Economics, and Organizational Change
groups.promise: Turn isolated experiments into a sequenced organizational program with value measures, ownership, funding, workforce preparation, and an operating rhythm.

groups.title: Applied AI Studios
groups.promise: Build enough to understand the mechanics, expose failure, and make better implementation decisions. No programming background is required.

groups.title: Capstone, From Opportunity to Governed Pilot
groups.promise: Convert one real organizational opportunity into a pilot that leadership can understand, challenge, measure, govern, and stop when necessary.
